notes: Jellyfin Ecosystem & Sync: Seamless multi-server connectivity with Quick Connect, QR instant pairing, fast profile switching, and Jellyfin 12 readiness.
Live TV & Interactive EPG: Stream live broadcast channels, explore electronic program guide grids, and review server DVR recordings.
Unified Dual Playback Engines: Instant runtime switching between Media3 (ExoPlayer) and libmpv with hardware decoding, Direct Play, and adaptive transcoding.
Advanced Anime Subtitles: Full native libmpv support for stylized ASS/SSA typography, track selection, and external subtitle loading.
Offline Downloads Engine: Resilient media downloader with paused/resumed transfers, error recovery, custom storage directories, and complete offline playback.
Server Operations & HUD: Direct server health inspection, active stream telemetry, and system maintenance directly from the client.
Live Sessions & Toast Dispatch: Monitor connected users and active playback sessions with options to send toast notifications and broadcast alerts.
Seerr Request Center: Native integration with Overseerr/Jellyseerr to explore, request, and monitor media availability.
Mobile QR Push Companion: Direct local Wi-Fi handshake to scan and push active authentication sessions straight to Aurelia TV.
Adaptive Jetpack Compose UI: Modern Material You design featuring dynamic Monet themes, AMOLED True Black mode, and custom typography.
